pr_body:
### What does it do?

Add Node 22 to workflows:

- allow matrices on every test type for consistency
- add node 22 to several test runs
- flatten runs to only two levels of dependency:
  - first: short checks (lint, pretty, build, changes)
  - second: all tests (cli, typescript, e2e, api, unit:front, unit:back)
- removes Node 18 from CI
  
Fixes required for Strapi to run with Node 22:

- update project template `better-sqlite3` package to a version that supports Node 22
- add 5.1.0 codemod to upgrade better-sqlite3 package in existing projects

### Why is it needed?

- Node 22 becomes active version October 22, 2024

### How to test it?

- the CI workflow should pass here
- Experimental: 0.0.0-experimental.9c7de54d8ce77e13047fc15ada33f937a068f1f2
  - `npx create-strapi-app@0.0.0-experimental.9c7de54d8ce77e13047fc15ada33f937a068f1f2`

### Related issue(s)/PR(s)

DX-1510

I can't figure out why the front end tests are so flaky here 😭

Locally they're fine on both node 20 and node 22, but on the CI random tests fail so often that I have to re-run about 10 times before they finally make it through. Anyone have any ideas? I don't want to merge this if it could cause the same problem elsewhere.
@innerdvations I supposed that it's not even the same tests that fail everytime ?

> @innerdvations I supposed that it's not even the same tests that fail everytime ?

It's really hard to tell, because there are almost always a few of the "An update to Select inside a test was not wrapped in act"

But there is a test or two that look like they legitimately fail, for example in [the most recent run](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/actions/runs/11128857652/job/30958268657?pr=21467) (and several previous runs) the error "[Unable to find role button](https://github.com/strapi/strapi/actions/runs/11128857652/job/30958268657?pr=21467#:~:text=19673-,Unable,-to%20find%20role)"

But also, if I run the tests enough time, eventually they pass. So I'm just confused about it at this point.

Update: It was because `--run-in-band` was accidentally removed, and when they run in parallel they're much flakier because of the tight timeouts. Added it back and it's fine now.

### Steps to reproduce the behavior

$ pnpm run develop

### Expected behavior

no DeprecationWarning

comments:
As seen in `package.json` the engines field lists
```json
"node": ">=18.0.0 <=20.x.x"
```
you are using Node 22 which is not supported and which deprecated the punycode module.
You should use Node 20
Closing as this is not a Strapi issue. Please see @kaaax0815 comment for resolution.

review_comments: This is just the version we generate new projects with, it wouldn't break any existing code, and old versions still work with Node 20. But if we generate new projects with a later version, the user doesn't have to figure out why node 22 doesn't work.
as long as v11 is compat with node 18 & 20 it's all good 👍
Yep, the only breaking changes are dropping support for versions of Node we don't support (node 21 and node <= 14 I think)
